name: ui-refactor
description: UI design reviewer distilled from Refactoring UI principles. Reviews screenshots, code, and descriptions for hierarchy, spacing, typography, color, depth, and polish — with concrete CSS fixes and named anti-patterns.

interface.shortDescription: Review and improve web interface design.
interface.longDescription: Review screenshots, CSS, and Tailwind for visual hierarchy, spacing, typography, color, depth, and polish.
defaultPrompt: Review this interface and identify its main design defects.
Refactor this UI for clearer hierarchy and spacing.
Improve this Tailwind layout without changing its behavior.
